title: Torii Lanes in Storm: Hidden Law
description: Torii Lanes in Storm unfolds across storm-bent shrine path where paper seals redirect hostile wind, pushing a 5-Titan Kami Titan to prove precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Torii Lanes in Storm: Hidden Law advances Kami Mirror Tempest: The Sacred Kingdoms test whether the Creator can cleanse Gate reflections without breaking shrine law or spirit contracts.
